{{Top}}
[[File:Dewback_Rider_EotECR.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Dewback/Legends|Dewbacks]] were reptiles native to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]]]
A '''reptile'''<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> (adjectival form '''reptilian'''), also known as a '''saurian'''<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref> or '''reptiloid'''<ref name="THG">''[[The Hutt Gambit]]''</ref> particularly when referring to a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], was a class of animal life. Reptiles were generally cold-[[Blood/Legends|blooded]], egg-laying, and covered with scales.

{{Species-stub}}
